description: This file defines classes and methods for retrieving process metrics from the /proc filesystem in Linux, specifically for Spark executor processes. It includes logic for reading process memory info, computing process trees, and aggregating JVM, Python, and other process metrics.

classes.name: ProcfsMetrics
classes.description: A case class holding aggregated memory and RSS metrics for JVM, Python, and other processes.

classes.name: ProcfsMetricsGetter
classes.description: A class for retrieving and aggregating process metrics from the /proc filesystem for Spark executors.

methods.name: addProcfsMetricsFromOneProcess
methods.description: Reads process info from /proc and updates metrics based on process type (Java, Python, or other).

methods.name: computeProcessTree
methods.description: Computes the set of process IDs in the current process tree.

methods.name: computeAllMetrics
methods.description: Aggregates metrics for all processes in the process tree.

methods.name: computePageSize
methods.description: Determines the system page size for memory calculations.
